notes.title: Big Experimental Patch
notes.notes:
**This patch introduces many changes that have the goal of scaling the difficulty as intended. Not with more enemies and chaos that can lead to frustrating random deaths, but with more challenging combats, meaningful and where both victories and defeats are earned by choices.**

Once we move to our backers' build, we will keep polishing the fight experience in harder difficulties to find the right spot.

Here are some of the changes in this patch. Please, keep in mind that many elements are not yet in place and things can be reverted at any time:

- Enemy number reduced, being a group of 3 the maximum regular group and limiting the number of enemies even in coop.
- Enemy group chance of being spawned reduced 15%, giving a bit of extra space between groups.
- Guards could also be broken when the energy of the Hunter was bigger than the energy of the Enemy or attacking from the back. However, that was almost a near impossible task in Solo. Now your energy level is multiplied by your combo counter, meaning that consecutive attacks against a guarding enemy could (or not) break the defence.
- Added a Breaking Guard meter per hit.

- Now the damage of Enemies scales with their difficulty. Being Base 1 blood slot, Delta 1.5, Gamma 2, Beta 2.5, Alpha 3.
- Now projectiles' speed scales with difficulty, implemented at this point on the Magnetic bomb and Nymph's Orbs. Damage stays the same.

- Vertical thrust now has better FX, SFX and timing.
- Vertical thrust adjustments to trigger when intended.
- Combo Ender forward better hit box register.
- Combo Ender forward now hits all enemies in a 3-meter radius, knocking down all of them.
- Combo Ender forward better FX/SFX

- Fixed a bug where interaction could reset other actions as jumping, dodging, swapping weapons or cooldowns.
- Fixed a bug where swapping Range/Melee will result in a reset of Range cooldowns.

- Added a new mutation. Quick reload. This mutation will allow exactly the bug above, swapping between Melee and Range will reset reload cooldowns.
- Mitral and Mitral First Gen reduced cooldown, being both faster than before. However, First Gen has a 10% quicker reload, while Mitral has a 30% quicker reload. This helps to justify the Biohack difference, since damage starts to be less meaningful when stacking mutations.

- Mutation Builder now assigns the mutation to the user instead of being random. In the future, we will also have a Mutation clearer where players will be able to clear Mutation ownership by a drop of blood. Also, keep in mind that once we have the 4 characters in place, most of the distribution issues will be fixed.

notes.title: New Patch

- Brontes AOE (Jump and Stomp) radius reduced from 25m to 23m to be more forgiving with the telegraphing.
- Brontes' damage to columns on normal movement reduced by 50%
- Brontes AOE damage in far distance is now 0.1 instead of 0.5

- New Melee attack implemented that replaces the weird animation when jumping in the vertical axis. This attack will trigger while being airborne, close to the enemy, and when executed, can do normal damage in normal situations, but up to 20 times more damage when enemies are in knockdown (Before, shield, armour and other mitigations). This is experimental until we find the sweet spot.

- Fixed bad animations that happened when you jump while being knockdown or while finishing an attack animation.

- Fixed HUD  for Mitral
- Fixed Beluga Cannon camera shake in other players.

- Enemy projectiles -Magnetic Bombs to start with- Now scale their speed by Enemy difficulty.

(This is the first step of many ahead to make harder difficulties to have fewer enemies, but way harder. The final vision of CRETE is not to have a mess where your choices become too arbitrary, but to increase the difficulty by tougher enemies, both in solo and coop. This will be paired with smaller groups of enemies.)

notes.title: Biome B and Boss B are now LIVE: Please read the patch notes for more INFO
notes.notes:
**BiomeB and BossB** Are now live.

- IMPORTANT: This is the first patch version of many ahead, and the second Biome is guaranteed to have issues. This could include collision issues, bad generation, balancing problems and of course unfinished assets and work-in-progress layout. While Achaean Rift is 50% of its final quality, Terpsichore Gardens is at 10%-15%.

With that said, now that we have an initial foundation, improving and polishing is way simpler and faster than the first step, so give it a go!

Another important change is that the chances of Alpha and Beta DNA are slightly increased in Terpsichore Gardens, go get'em.

Next polishing patch will come in some hours from now. And next week work will be oriented towards giving more flavour and o to the second Boss and the second Biome.

You should also expect a patch very soon that will make the Laboratory more functional and the alert levels more playable in Endless mode.

Please be patience, we are only one dev and one artist, so things take time :)

Thanks again for playing CRETE!

notes.title: New patch and a personal thank you!
notes.notes:
This patch contains several critical changes. But before that, 
I want to use this opportunity to thank every single one of you for all the love, feedback, reports and even exploits you are finding in the game.
We read every piece of feedback (thousands of reports in 2 weeks), we check most of Twitch streams, Youtube videos and gameplays in Bilibili.
I can be watching a live stream on my second screen and fixing in real time a bug the streamer is finding, right away.

We are a very small team with a pretty big idea: To bring challenging, meaningful, cooperative experiences set in a unique universe. And we will deliver that idea while polishing all the issues you are helping us to find.

Now, let's go to the juice:

- We still working on the secondary sockets design. They might not be available in this playtest. But yes, this is how they will work:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43043832/ffd3f348e5a3530c9b97d2bbb863900cc1e1e6e8.jpg

Each node (Core, Melee, Range, Mobility) will have 3 sockets. The Big socket will apply the mutation quality as it is, so if you apply a mutation quality 5, you will get the full effect of 5.
The medium socket subtracts 2 qualities from the base quality, so if you apply a 5-quality mutation, it will become a 3-quality socket.
Finally, the small socket will subtract 4 qualities, in other words, every mutation applied to that small socket will become always a quality 1 mutation.

You will have to apply to mutations in order from big to small. When you apply your first mutation to a big socket, the medium socket becomes available and so on. Now, when you override a mutation in a big socket, the smaller sockets in the node hierarchy will be destroyed. If for example I have my Big, medium and small sockets with mutations, and I override the medium-size socket, that will automatically destroy the small socket mutation.

Finally, some mutations will have synergies, corruptions, states and inestabilities when combined. More on that in the future.
(And yes, mutations will transform your designs, VFX, models way more of what is happening now. For example, necrosis will necrotize your arm, mutilatina will hypertrophy it, etc.)

Remember, they are not yet available!

More changes:

- Added a new experimental mutation: Radiocine, with 3 functional effects.

- Implemented some initial SFX/FX to Radiocine.

- Fixed a bug where your low energy could kill you while watching the boss cinematic.

- Blood burst now can’t heal fainted players.

- Fixed a bug where you could shoot a faster fire-rate smash clicking automatic guns.

- Fixed a bug where Hephasteus hammer doesn’t show when using the ability.

- Added collisions to Arsenals.

- Chrys energy colour a bit more yellow-orange.

- Dash now has a bit of buffer. Instant-cancelling a Melee-dash is still as effective as before, however, if you hit with your Melee and you instant-dash, the Melee animation will keep playing a bit more from the first hitbox so the sword can cut through. The input buffering is 0.2 at this moment.

- Blocking has also a bit of buffer to avoid glitchy Block-Melee spam.

- Run attack energy consumption increased 50%. Sprint and run attack now consume the same energy. The idea is to promote a second or third combo impact.

- Armour of enemies now scales stronger with higher difficulties.

- Higher difficulties AIs are now a bit more reactive, “smarter”.

- Improved hit animations on enemies that sometimes glitched while they were blocking.

- Improved enemy blocking to feel a bit more reactive and countering the player.

- Improved sound and feel of Guardian’s spears (sorry, I know they are scary).

- More network optimizations.

- More layout / set dressing polishing.


This patch might increase the difficulty in Biomes 2 and 3. This is not a representation of the final game. We are experimenting before we get it right.

Good luck and good DNA-Hunt.

notes.title: New patch with major changes - Blood Slot Regeneration system is live
notes.notes:
Hello! 

We are including the Blood Slot Regeneration system and a health rework. This is hugely experimental and we appreciate any bug reports or feedback. Even more when playing coop.

Maximum health is now 5.
Players regenerate blood (health) per slot. This means that health slowly recovers, stopping at the maximum of the damaged blood slot.
For example, if your health is 3.5 you will recover to 4, and if your health is 1.1, you will recover to 2, etc.

Enemy regular damage is still 1 entire slot, meaning that you will still lose that blood slot, However, enemies like myriads or friendly fire cause a fraction of a blood slot, so that damage can be easily recovered.

For example, it takes more than 5 hits to remove the health of an ally.

We are also notifying friendly fire warning when the injured ally is about to lose the blood slot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43043832/9e262e28e9468d9745afb2d81218ab90db3318d6.jpg


This patch also includes crucial bug fixes, including:

- Breaking eggs and doors replication for mid-match joiners and when players play quite far from each other.

-The menu is slightly more transparent and notifies that the game is never paused.
-By default, you are now invulnerable for the first 40 seconds of starting a level. Avoiding accidental unwanted friendly fire.

notes.title: New patch
notes.notes:
-Procedural dialogs and more voice lines added.
-A clearer flow in the main island for new players (remember that we are still in alpha so there is a lack of backstory and context).
-New procedural rocks, modules and ratio.
-Damage little adjustments.

notes.title: New patch
notes.notes:
- Myriads updates in amount, animations and balance.
- Procgen parameters update. Minor difficulty tweaks.
-Fixed a bug where the timer didn't stop when opening the gates.
-Fixed a bug where you could bring health from the main island.
-Fixed a bug where in lower settings characters lost joints close to you.

notes.title: New experimental patch
notes.notes:
New enemies, plants and spawners were added.
Better interaction system.

notes.title: New patch improving UI and fixing gates
notes.notes:
Patch 0.5.1.3 Includes the following changes:
-Improved UI, mission HUDs and sound elements.
-Yellow gate fixed.
-Cryoeggs and Estamen plants now remove the UI after being taken.
-Experimental combat report after death or by pressing left Alt.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1.2
notes.notes:
New patch includes the following updates:
-Increased ratio of health drops in Cryoeggs.
-Minor UI fixes.
-Persistent quest display.

notes.title: Alpha 0.5.1.1 Update.
notes.notes:
A new patch has been released that includes the following fixes:

-Hit boxes in the menu aligned.
-Chat only focused on the keyboard.
-Stairs in the temple are now corrected to the correct height.
-Doors in the temples should open with the correct button.
-Constant UI update of current progression.
-New voice lines added on Demian to avoid repetition.
-Volume adjusted on Jun intro lines.
-Temples brightness increased.
-Difficulty decreased slightly in the first biome.
-Hestia placeholder now replicates.
-Experimental session info due to lack of data retrieving on the steam sessions.
-Health drop in eggs increased from 10% to 15%
